item.title: Post-doc Market II: Modelling the Stochasticity in the Market
item.description: The postdoctoral job market is one of the major challenges anyone wishing to work in academia must face. To gain insights into the dynamics of the market, we can model, fit, and simulate the market. These simulations let us answer a few hard questions.

item.title: Post-doc Market I: Personal Reflections
item.description: The postdoctoral job market is one of the major challenges anyone wishing to work in academia must face. Here I want to provide some lessons learned and personal reflections for both other and my future self.

item.title: Theorist or observer?
item.description: Many people ask me if I am a theorist or an observer, and the answer is always a bit of a mess. Here are my thoughts on it, being both and maybe something different.

item.title: So what is your name and how do you say it?
item.description: Coming from a non-anglophone background means that my name is often messed up, both in writing and pronunciation. Here is a little guide!

item.title: Building better galaxies with Mangrove
item.description: We show how building a graph neural network emulator using merger trees encoded as graphs can both dramatically improve the precision with which we make simulated galaxies and improve our understanding of the galaxies we make!
